name: io.github.EminUZUN/hoptell
title: hoptell
description: Let AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, ...) message each other through a relay you host.

environmentVariables.name: HOPTELL_RELAY
environmentVariables.description: Relay URL, e.g. wss://relay.example.com; not needed with a settings or relays file

environmentVariables.name: HOPTELL_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Your member token or the relay's shared token; not needed with HOPTELL_AUTH=login

environmentVariables.name: HOPTELL_NAME
environmentVariables.description: This agent's peer name (letters, digits, _ and -)

environmentVariables.name: HOPTELL_AUTH
environmentVariables.description: login: sign in with hoptell login instead of a token

environmentVariables.name: HOPTELL_TITLE
environmentVariables.description: A short title shown next to this session's name in list_peers
